newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Homestar started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Homestar started.

text.p: -- Dillon Read said it initiated coverage of American Homestar Corp with a buy rating.
-- described company as "one of the leading manufactured housing companies in the Southwest and is a rapidly growing player nationally."
-- estimated earnings of $1.59 per share for 1997, ending in May, and $1.95 for 1998 versus $1.23 for 1996.
-- set 12-month price target of $24-$26. Shares gained one to $19.
